$comment: Angelic Support (OS Atlas model, wiki 2026-11). Surf = Astral Projection (10 s; decelerating arc barrier, 600 range at 2286/s, hits each enemy once: 1330+175 % core, 170+85 % player KB, 120+60 % dmg). Whirlpool = Cosmic Expanse (20 s; expanding ring of light: 1340+179 % core, 180+89 % KB, 180+89 % dmg; if it hits it lingers and shrinks over ~1 s, later hits 50 % / 75 % on the core; ours: a smaller ring that hits twice more). Aqua Ring = Celestial Intervention (35 s; guardian for 2 s, heals 5 % of max Stagger every 0.25 s, size 450 → radius 225; any ally who would be KO'd is pulled to it with 75 % Stagger, once per ally). Was the Asher kit until 2026-11-06 (now Hisuian Arcanine). Balance pass 2026-11-06 (bots made it 68 % / 85 %): Surf 12 s, radius 65, ×0.8 ball and ×0.85 player KB; Whirlpool one follow-up hit; Aqua Ring 45 s, 4 % per pulse; Stagger growth 425. Player knockback = OS × 1.875; power % → powerRatio.

moves.name: Surf
moves.desc: Send out a slowing wave that passes through enemies, hitting each one (and the ball) once.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.desc: A ring of water bursts out around you, then swirls inward, hitting nearby enemies once more.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.desc: Raise a ring of healing water for 2 s: allies inside heal 4 % every 0.25 s. Any ally who would be KO'd meanwhile is pulled into it with 75 % Stagger (once each).
